sourceText:
Hola, mundo.
El gato duerme en la casa.
Gracias por leer con nosotros.
translatedText:
Hey, world.
The cat sleeps in the house.
Thanks for reading with us.

checks.Name: screen_capture_and_ocr
checks.Detail: The captured Spanish sample must contain gato and casa.

checks.Name: local_translation
checks.Detail: The real local translation must contain cat and house.

checks.Name: side_panel_visible
checks.Detail: The translated result is displayed in the side panel.

checks.Name: copy_roundtrip
checks.Detail: Copy uses the actual side-panel action; previous clipboard text is restored immediately.

checks.Name: missing_key_message
checks.Detail: Selecting DeepL without a key must show an actionable message and keep the app alive.

limitations: Cloud providers are not called; missing credentials are checked locally.
Preview is a WPF render composite; sample-capture.png contains actual captured pixels.
This exercises SnapAsync directly. The global translation hotkey requires a separate live input check.
